<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>TravelGenie — Plan Smarter. Travel Better.</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Poppins:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>/* =========================================================
   0. CSS VARIABLES
========================================================= */
:root {
  --primary-blue: #2563EB;
  --primary-blue-hover: #1D4ED8;
  --cta-blue-start: #2F80ED;
  --cta-blue-end: #4FACFE;
  --gradient-blue: #4FACFE;
  --bg: #F7FAFF;
  --card-white: #FFFFFF;
  --light-blue: #EEF5FF;
  --text: #1F2937;
  --text-muted: #6B7686;
  --heading-dark: #1E3A8A;
  --border: #E5EDF9;
  --shadow-sm: 0 4px 14px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.08);
  --shadow-md: 0 10px 30px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.12);
  --shadow-lg: 0 20px 50px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.16);
  --radius-sm: 10px;
  --radius-md: 18px;
  --radius-lg: 26px;
  --sidebar-w: 220px;
  --font-heading: 'Space Grotesk', 'Poppins', sans-serif;
  --ease: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}
 
[data-theme="dark"] {
  --bg: #0F1420;
  --card-white: #171E2E;
  --light-blue: #1D2740;
  --text: #EAF0FB;
  --text-muted: #8D97AC;
  --border: #262F45;
  --shadow-sm: 0 4px 14px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
  --shadow-md: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
  --shadow-lg: 0 20px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
}
 
/* =========================================================
   1. RESET & BASE
========================================================= */
* { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
 
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
 
body {
  font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
  font-size: 15px;
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--text);
  overflow-x: hidden;
  transition: background 0.3s var(--ease), color 0.3s var(--ease);
}
 
h1, h2, h3, .logo, .cta-label { font-family: var(--font-heading); }
 
img { display: block; max-width: 100%; }
 
button { font-family: inherit; cursor: pointer; border: none; background: none; }
 
a { text-decoration: none; color: inherit; }
 
/* =========================================================
   2. FLOATING HAMBURGER (visible when sidebar closed)
========================================================= */
.hamburger-fab {
  position: fixed;
  top: 24px;
  left: 24px;
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--card-white);
  color: var(--primary-blue);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
  z-index: 1200;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transform: scale(0.7);
  transition: opacity 0.35s var(--ease), transform 0.35s var(--ease);
}
 
.hamburger-fab.visible {
  opacity: 1;
  pointer-events: auto;
  transform: scale(1);
}
 
.hamburger-fab:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); transform: scale(1.06); }
 
/* =========================================================
   3. SIDEBAR
========================================================= */
.sidebar {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  height: 100vh;
  width: var(--sidebar-w);
  background: var(--card-white);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
  z-index: 1100;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  padding: 20px 14px;
  transform: translateX(0);
  transition: transform 0.4s var(--ease);
}
 
.sidebar.closed { transform: translateX(-100%); }
 
.sidebar-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 0 6px 20px 6px;
}
 
.logo {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text);
}
 
.logo em {
  font-style: normal;
  color: var(--primary-blue);
}
 
.sidebar-close {
  width: 30px;
  height: 30px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  transition: background 0.2s var(--ease), color 0.2s var(--ease);
}
 
.sidebar-close:hover { background: var(--light-blue); color: var(--primary-blue); }
 
.sidebar-nav {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
  margin-top: 8px;
}
 
.nav-divider {
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--border);
  margin: 12px 6px;
}
 
.nav-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 9px 12px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: 13.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
  transition: background 0.2s var(--ease), color 0.2s var(--ease), transform 0.2s var(--ease);
}
 
.nav-icon { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
 
.nav-item:hover {
  background: var(--light-blue);
  color: var(--primary-blue);
  transform: translateX(2px);
}
 
.nav-item.active {
  background: var(--primary-blue);
  color: white;
  font-weight: 600;
}
 
.sidebar-footer-card {
  margin-top: auto;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-blue), var(--gradient-blue));
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 20px 16px;
  color: white;
  text-align: center;
}
 
.sidebar-footer-icon {
  width: 42px;
  height: 42px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  margin: 0 auto 12px auto;
}
 
.sidebar-footer-card p {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.4;
}
 
.sidebar-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(15, 20, 32, 0.45);
  z-index: 1050;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity 0.35s var(--ease);
}
 
.sidebar-overlay.visible { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }
 
/* =========================================================
   4. MAIN LAYOUT
========================================================= */
.main {
  margin-left: var(--sidebar-w);
  min-height: 100vh;
  transition: margin-left 0.4s var(--ease);
  padding: 20px 36px 0 36px;
}
 
.main.expanded { margin-left: 0; }
 
/* =========================================================
   5. TOP NAVIGATION
========================================================= */
.topbar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 22px;
}
 
.menu-btn {
  width: 42px;
  height: 42px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--card-white);
  color: var(--text);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  transition: box-shadow 0.2s var(--ease), transform 0.2s var(--ease);
}
 
.menu-btn:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); transform: translateY(-1px); }
 
.topbar-right {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
}
 
.theme-toggle {
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--card-white);
  color: var(--text);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  transition: box-shadow 0.2s var(--ease), transform 0.4s var(--ease);
}
 
.theme-toggle:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); transform: rotate(20deg); }
 
.btn {
  padding: 9px 20px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  display: inline-block;
  transition: transform 0.2s var(--ease), box-shadow 0.2s var(--ease), background 0.2s var(--ease), color 0.2s var(--ease);
}
 
.btn-outline {
  background: var(--card-white);
  color: var(--primary-blue);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}
 
.btn-outline:hover { background: var(--primary-blue); color: white; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }
 
.btn-filled {
  background: var(--primary-blue);
  color: white;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.28);
}
 
.btn-filled:hover { background: var(--primary-blue-hover); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 12px 26px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.35); }
 
/* =========================================================
   6. HERO SECTION
========================================================= */
.hero {
  position: relative;
  height: 430px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
}
 
.hero-media { position: absolute; inset: 0; }
 
.hero-img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: center;
}
 
.hero-overlay {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
}
 
.hero-content {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 24px 24px;
}
 
.hero-heading {
  font-family: var(--font-heading);
  font-size: 36px;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.2;
  color: #16233D;
  letter-spacing: -0.5px;
}
 
.grad-text {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-blue), var(--gradient-blue));
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  background-clip: text;
  color: transparent;
}
 
.hero-subheading {
  margin-top: 10px;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: #3E4A63;
  max-width: 440px;
  font-weight: 400;
}
 
/* AI Prompt Card */
.prompt-card {
  margin-top: 24px;
  width: min(560px, 90vw);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
  backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  animation: floatCard 5s ease-in-out infinite;
}
 
@keyframes floatCard {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
  50% { transform: translateY(-8px); }
}
 
.prompt-card-icon {
  width: 42px;
  height: 42px;
  min-width: 42px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-blue), var(--gradient-blue));
  color: white;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}
 
.prompt-card-body { flex: 1; text-align: left; overflow: hidden; }
 
.prompt-title {
  display: block;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--heading-dark);
  margin-bottom: 2px;
}
 
.prompt-input {
  width: 100%;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 14.5px;
  color: var(--text);
  outline: none;
}
 
.prompt-input::placeholder { color: #8590A6; }
 
.prompt-send {
  width: 42px;
  height: 42px;
  min-width: 42px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--primary-blue);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.35);
  transition: transform 0.2s var(--ease), background 0.2s var(--ease);
}
 
.prompt-send:hover { background: var(--primary-blue-hover); transform: scale(1.08) rotate(8deg); }
 
/* Suggestion chips */
.chip-row {
  margin-top: 14px;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px;
}
 
.chip {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 7px 13px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  color: #33415A;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  transition: transform 0.2s var(--ease), background 0.2s var(--ease), color 0.2s var(--ease);
}
 
.chip:hover {
  background: var(--primary-blue);
  color: white;
  transform: translateY(-3px);
}
 
/* =========================================================
   7. POPULAR DESTINATIONS
========================================================= */
.destinations { margin-top: 48px; }
 
.section-heading-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}
 
.section-heading-row h2 { font-size: 21px; font-weight: 700; }
 
.view-all {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--primary-blue);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  transition: gap 0.2s var(--ease);
}
 
.view-all:hover { gap: 8px; }
 
.destination-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 18px;
}
 
.destination-card {
  background: var(--card-white);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  transition: transform 0.35s var(--ease), box-shadow 0.35s var(--ease);
}
 
.destination-card:hover { transform: translateY(-8px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); }
 
.destination-img-wrap {
  position: relative;
  height: 148px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
 
.destination-img-wrap img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  transition: transform 0.5s var(--ease);
}
 
.destination-card:hover .destination-img-wrap img { transform: scale(1.08); }
 
.rating-badge {
  position: absolute;
  top: 12px;
  right: 12px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92);
  backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
  padding: 5px 10px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #1F2937;
}
 
.rating-badge small { color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 500; }
 
.destination-body { padding: 14px 16px 16px 16px; }
 
.destination-body h3 { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 9px; }
 
.destination-meta {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}
 
.destination-meta div:last-child { text-align: right; }
 
.destination-meta span {
  display: block;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-bottom: 2px;
}
 
.destination-meta strong { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; }
 
.btn-explore {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 9px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--light-blue);
  color: var(--primary-blue);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 6px;
  transition: background 0.2s var(--ease), color 0.2s var(--ease), gap 0.2s var(--ease);
}
 
.btn-explore:hover { background: var(--primary-blue); color: white; gap: 9px; }
 
/* =========================================================
   8. AI CTA BANNER
========================================================= */
.cta {
  margin-top: 48px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--cta-blue-start), var(--cta-blue-end));
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 38px 42px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 28px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}
 
.cta-text { max-width: 560px; position: relative; z-index: 2; }
 
.cta-label {
  display: inline-block;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
  color: white;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  padding: 6px 14px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}
 
.cta-text h2 {
  color: white;
  font-size: 25px;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.3;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}
 
.cta-text p {
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
  font-size: 13.5px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}
 
.btn-cta {
  background: white;
  color: var(--primary-blue);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
}
 
.btn-cta:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 14px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2); }
 
.cta-illustration {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
 
.star { animation: twinkle 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; }
.s2 { animation-delay: 0.5s; }
.s3 { animation-delay: 1s; }
.s4 { animation-delay: 1.5s; }
 
@keyframes twinkle {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 0.3; transform: scale(0.8); }
  50% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.2); }
}
 
/* =========================================================
   9. FOOTER
========================================================= */
.footer {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 30px 24px 26px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.7;
}
 
.footer a { color: var(--primary-blue); font-weight: 600; }
.footer a:hover { color: var(--primary-blue-hover); }

/* =========================================================
   10. SCROLL REVEAL
========================================================= */
.reveal {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(28px);
  transition: opacity 0.7s var(--ease), transform 0.7s var(--ease);
}
 
.reveal.in-view { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
 
/* =========================================================
   11. RESPONSIVE
========================================================= */
@media (max-width: 1080px) {
  .destination-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
  .cta { flex-direction: column; text-align: center; align-items: center; }
  .cta-text { max-width: 100%; }
}
 
@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .auth-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
 
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .sidebar { transform: translateX(-100%); }
  .sidebar.open { transform: translateX(0); }
  .main { margin-left: 0; padding: 20px 24px 0; }
  .hamburger-fab { display: none; }
  .menu-btn { display: flex; }
}
 
@media (min-width: 901px) {
  .sidebar-overlay { display: none; }
}
 
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .hero { height: auto; min-height: 520px; }
  .hero-heading { font-size: 28px; }
  .hero-content { padding: 32px 18px; }
  .destination-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .cta { padding: 30px 22px; }
  .cta-text h2 { font-size: 21px; }
  .cta-illustration svg { width: 150px; height: 120px; }
}
 
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .main { padding: 16px 14px 0; }
  .topbar-right { gap: 8px; }
  .btn { padding: 9px 16px; font-size: 13px; }
  .prompt-card { padding: 12px; gap: 10px; }
}
 
/* Reduced motion */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  * { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; }
}
 
/* Keyboard focus visibility */
a:focus-visible, button:focus-visible, input:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--primary-blue);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}</style>
</head>
<body>
 
<!-- Floating hamburger, visible only when sidebar is closed -->
<button class="hamburger-fab" id="hamburgerFab" aria-label="Open menu">
  <svg width="20" height="16" viewBox="0 0 20 16" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
    <path d="M1 1H19" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M1 8H19" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M1 15H19" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </svg>
</button>
 
<!-- Sidebar overlay for mobile -->
<div class="sidebar-overlay" id="sidebarOverlay"></div>
 
<!-- Sidebar -->
<aside class="sidebar" id="sidebar">
  <div class="sidebar-header">
    <a href="#heroSection" class="logo">
      <svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
        <path d="M21.44 3.56L2.98 10.3c-.86.31-.85 1.53.02 1.83l7.53 2.58 2.58 7.53c.3.87 1.52.88 1.83.02l6.74-18.46c.26-.72-.44-1.42-1.16-1.16 0-.01-.08-.01-.08-.01z" fill="url(#logoGrad)"/>
        <defs>
          <linearGradient id="logoGrad" x1="2" y1="3" x2="22" y2="22" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
            <stop stop-color="#2F80ED"/>
            <stop offset="1" stop-color="#4FACFE"/>
          </linearGradient>
        </defs>
      </svg>
      <span>Travel<em>Genie</em></span>
    </a>
    <button class="sidebar-close" id="sidebarClose" aria-label="Close menu">
      <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
        <path d="M1 1L15 15M15 1L1 15" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      </svg>
    </button>
  </div>
 
  <nav class="sidebar-nav">
    <a href="#heroSection" class="nav-item active">
      <span class="nav-icon">
        <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><path d="M3 11L12 3L21 11" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M5 9.5V20a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h4v-6h4v6h4a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V9.5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>
      </span>
      <span>Home</span>
    </a>
    <a href="{% url 'about' %}" class="nav-item">
      <span class="nav-icon">
        <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"/><path d="M12 11v6" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="12" cy="7.5" r="1" fill="currentColor"/></svg>
      </span>
      <span>About</span>
    </a>
    <a href="{% url 'contact' %}" class="nav-item">
      <span class="nav-icon">
        <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><rect x="3" y="5" width="18" height="14" rx="2" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"/><path d="M3 6.5L12 13L21 6.5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>
      </span>
      <span>Contact</span>
    </a>
 
    <div class="nav-divider"></div>

    <!-- AI CTA Banner -->
    <section class="cta reveal" id="aboutSection">

<script>document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
 
  /* =========================================================
     SIDEBAR TOGGLE
  ========================================================= */
  const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
  const mainContent = document.getElementById('mainContent');
  const hamburgerFab = document.getElementById('hamburgerFab');
  const menuBtn = document.getElementById('menuBtn');
  const sidebarClose = document.getElementById('sidebarClose');
  const sidebarOverlay = document.getElementById('sidebarOverlay');
 
  const isMobile = () => window.innerWidth <= 900;
 
  function openSidebar() {
    if (isMobile()) {
      sidebar.classList.add('open');
      sidebarOverlay.classList.add('visible');
    } else {
      sidebar.classList.remove('closed');
      mainContent.classList.remove('expanded');
      hamburgerFab.classList.remove('visible');
    }
  }
 
  function closeSidebar() {
    if (isMobile()) {
      sidebar.classList.remove('open');
      sidebarOverlay.classList.remove('visible');
    } else {
      sidebar.classList.add('closed');
      mainContent.classList.add('expanded');
      hamburgerFab.classList.add('visible');
    }
  }
 
  menuBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const currentlyOpen = isMobile()
      ? sidebar.classList.contains('open')
      : !sidebar.classList.contains('closed');
    currentlyOpen ? closeSidebar() : openSidebar();
  });
 
  sidebarClose.addEventListener('click', closeSidebar);
  hamburgerFab.addEventListener('click', openSidebar);
  sidebarOverlay.addEventListener('click', closeSidebar);
 
  // Reset sidebar state cleanly when crossing the mobile/desktop breakpoint
  let lastIsMobile = isMobile();
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    const nowMobile = isMobile();
    if (nowMobile !== lastIsMobile) {
      sidebar.classList.remove('open', 'closed');
      mainContent.classList.remove('expanded');
      sidebarOverlay.classList.remove('visible');
      hamburgerFab.classList.remove('visible');
      lastIsMobile = nowMobile;
    }
  });
 
  /* =========================================================
     THEME TOGGLE
  ========================================================= */
  const themeToggle = document.getElementById('themeToggle');
  const themeIconSun = document.getElementById('themeIconSun');
  const themeIconMoon = document.getElementById('themeIconMoon');
 
  let currentTheme = 'light';
 
  themeToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
    currentTheme = currentTheme === 'light' ? 'dark' : 'light';
    document.body.setAttribute('data-theme', currentTheme);
    const isDark = currentTheme === 'dark';
    themeIconSun.style.display = isDark ? 'none' : 'block';
    themeIconMoon.style.display = isDark ? 'block' : 'none';
  });
 
  /* =========================================================
     SCROLL REVEAL
  ========================================================= */
  const revealEls = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
 
  const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach((entry) => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        entry.target.classList.add('in-view');
        revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.15 });
 
  revealEls.forEach((el) => revealObserver.observe(el));
 
  /* =========================================================
     SUGGESTION CHIPS -> FILL PROMPT INPUT
  ========================================================= */
  const promptInput = document.getElementById('promptInput');
  const chips = document.querySelectorAll('.chip');
 
  const chipPrompts = {
    'Family Trip': 'Plan a 5-day family-friendly trip with kid activities',
    'Solo Trip': 'Plan a 7-day solo trip for self-care, good food, and photography',
    'Budget Trip': 'Plan a 5-day trip to Japan under $2,000',
    'Adventure': 'Plan an adrenaline-packed 6-day adventure trip'
  };
 
  chips.forEach((chip) => {
    chip.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const label = chip.textContent.trim();
      promptInput.value = chipPrompts[label] || label;
      promptInput.focus();
    });
  });
 
  /* =========================================================
     PROMPT SEND BUTTON
  ========================================================= */
  const promptSend = document.getElementById('promptSend');
  function handleSend() {
    const value = promptInput.value.trim();
    if (!value) {
      promptInput.focus();
      return;
    }
    promptSend.style.transform = 'scale(0.9)';
    setTimeout(() => { promptSend.style.transform = ''; }, 180);
    // Placeholder action: in production this would route to the AI planner
    console.log('TravelGenie prompt submitted:', value);
  }
 
  promptSend.addEventListener('click', handleSend);
  promptInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') handleSend();
  });
 
  /* =========================================================
     SMOOTH SCROLL FOR NAV LINKS
  ========================================================= */
  document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach((link) => {
    link.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      const targetId = link.getAttribute('href');
      const target = document.querySelector(targetId);
      if (target) {
        e.preventDefault();
        target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
        if (isMobile()) closeSidebar();
      }
    });
  });
 
});
 </script>
</body>
</html>
